newsitem.title: USA: HCC Insurance says gets A.M. Best upgrade.
newsitem.headline: HCC Insurance says gets A.M. Best upgrade.

text.p: HCC Insurance Holdings Inc on Monday said that rating agency A.M. Best has given HCC's insurance company subsidiaries an A+ rating.
Houston Casualty Co, HCCH's largest subsidiary, and Trafalgar Insurance Co were upgraded to A+ IX from A.
U.S. Specialty Insurance Co, a recent acquisition, was also rated A+.
Wholly-owned AVEMCO Insurance Co's rating was reaffirmed at A+ VII, the company said.

In a press release, the company said this upgrade was the result of many years of disciplined underwriting, producing profitable results and substantial growth in net earnings and statutory capital and surplus.
